fitReason: The current group links haptic and contact mechanics to algorithmic robot manipulation, with active postdoctoral supervision independently documented. This provides a concrete CS-facing learning/control topic beyond the broader haptic-device program; a short visitor would still need a tightly scoped project and host agreement.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full July 2026 primary methods verify PPO/Rapid Motor Adaptation policies operating an actual 16-DoF Allegro V4 hand mounted on a Franka Research 3. The learned policy sends joint-position targets to conventional low-level PD control and observes proprioceptive history only. The arm sets palm orientation and then stays fixed; camera/AprilTag measurements are for post-hoc evaluation. Physical tests cover three objects and four palm tilts with fabricated fingertip variants. This is learned in-hand rotation, not autonomous grasp acquisition or moving-arm manipulation. The manuscript explicitly limits generalization and systematic external-perturbation evidence. Its 83% gated success measure requires at least ten seconds of maintained grasp and 0.15 turns, not a full rotation. Co-first author Shihan Lu is independently listed as Colgate’s current postdoctoral advisee.
